title: MRCL Reactive Music
description: A reactive music pack for the MRCL Code Lyoko server
body:
A Code Lyoko-themed Reactive song pack made for use in the MRCL Server. Will be updated as MRCL updates and new biome tags get added to the server!

Currently includes:
- 2 songs for the main menu
- 2 songs for Tower Interior
- 3 songs for the Ice Sector
- 2 songs for the Forest Sector
- 2 songs for the Desert Sector
- 2 songs for the Mountain Sector
- 3 songs for Sector 5
- 1 song for Sector 5's Celestial Dome
- 1 song for Sector 5's Core
- 3 songs for the Network/Digital Sea
- 1 song for The Cortex
- 1 song for the Volcano Replika
- 3 songs for Earth/Kadic during sunrise and day time
- 1 song for Kadic/Earth at sunset/night
- 1 song for the lab room in the factory
- 1 song for the scanner room in the factory
- 3 songs for the XANA Void
- 1 song for the Taiga Replika

And, a few that don't work due to Reactive's NEARBY_MOBS tag being finnicky:
- 6 battle themes + 1 sector specific battle theme for all four surface sectors and the Volcano Replika
- 3 battle themes for Sector 5
- 1 battle theme for the Cortex
- 1 battle theme for Earth
- 1 "boss theme" for if a Tower is being attacked
- 2 "boss themes" for if the Core is being attacked
